details:
- CVE-2024-0409: fix incorrect cursor private key usage in Xwayland/Xephyr that
  caused XSELINUX devPrivates corruption
- CVE-2025-26597: fix buffer overflow in XkbChangeTypesOfKey() by properly resizing
  key syms and actions when nGroups is zero
- CVE-2025-26594: fix root cursor lifetime handling to prevent use-after-free
  and stale references
